ideas.title: The Minnesota Fraud Case: A Deep Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the Minnesota fraud case and the resignation of top prosecutors. What are the implications of the case and how does it relate to the broader issue of fraud in the state?
questions: What are the details of the $250M fraud case?
What led to the resignation of top prosecutors?
ideas.insight: The Minnesota fraud case has the potential to be a major scandal. By following the money and analyzing the data, we can uncover the truth behind the case and the resignation of top prosecutors.
